================================================================================
                    DocuGener - Quick Start Guide
================================================================================

Thank you for downloading DocuGener! This guide will help you get started
with the portable executable version.

================================================================================
QUICK START
================================================================================

1. Double-click DocuGener.exe to start the application
2. Open your web browser and go to: http://localhost:5000
3. Press Ctrl+Click anywhere on your screen to capture screenshots
4. Use the web interface to organize and export your captures

================================================================================
DETAILED USAGE
================================================================================

STARTING THE APPLICATION
------------------------
- Simply double-click DocuGener.exe
- A command window will appear - keep it open while using DocuGener
- The application will start automatically
- You'll see: "Web interface available at http://localhost:5000"

ACCESSING THE WEB INTERFACE
----------------------------
- Open any web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, etc.)
- Navigate to: http://localhost:5000
- The DocuGener interface will load automatically

CAPTURING SCREENSHOTS
---------------------
1. Make sure the status shows "Recording" (green indicator)
2. Press and hold the Ctrl key
3. Left-click anywhere on your screen
4. A screenshot will be captured with a red pointer highlight
5. The capture will appear in the web interface automatically

MANAGING YOUR CAPTURES
-----------------------
- View all captures in chronological order
- Add descriptions: Type in the text box below each image
- Delete captures: Click the trash icon (🗑️) on any capture
- Pause/Resume: Use the control panel buttons to stop/start capturing

EXPORTING YOUR DOCUMENTATION
----------------------------
1. Click the "Export" button in the control panel
2. Choose your format:
   - PowerPoint (.pptx) - Creates a presentation
   - PDF - Creates a PDF document
3. Click "Export" and the file will download to your Downloads folder

PROJECT MANAGEMENT
------------------
- Create projects to organize different documentation sets
- Save current captures to a project
- Load previous projects to continue working
- Switch between projects easily

================================================================================
TIPS
================================================================================

✓ Plan your documentation steps before starting
✓ Add clear descriptions to each capture
✓ Use the pause feature when you need to set up your screen
✓ Export regularly to save your work
✓ The application creates a "captures" folder in the same directory
  where screenshots are stored

================================================================================
TROUBLESHOOTING
================================================================================

Problem: Browser shows "This site can't be reached"
Solution: Make sure DocuGener.exe is running and the command window is open

Problem: Screenshots not capturing
Solution: 
- Check that status shows "Recording" (green)
- Make sure you're pressing Ctrl+Click (not just Click)
- Try pausing and resuming capture

Problem: Can't see the web interface
Solution:
- Make sure you're going to http://localhost:5000 (not https://)
- Try refreshing the page
- Check that no firewall is blocking the connection

Problem: Export not working
Solution:
- Make sure you have at least one capture
- Check your browser's download settings
- Try a different export format

================================================================================
SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS
================================================================================

- Windows 10 or later
- No Python installation required (all dependencies included)
- Any modern web browser
- Administrator privileges may be required for some screen capture features

================================================================================
DATA STORAGE
================================================================================

DocuGener stores your data in the following locations (relative to DocuGener.exe):

- captures/          - All screenshot images
- captures/metadata.json - Capture information
- projects.db        - Project database

You can backup these files to save your work.

================================================================================
SUPPORT
================================================================================

For more detailed documentation, visit the project repository:
https://github.com/rbriggs-cbt/DocuGener

For issues or questions, please check the documentation in the docs/ folder
or open an issue on GitHub.
